info.name: ImageKit Account Management API File Metadata API

params.name: fileId
params.description: The unique `fileId` of the uploaded file. `fileId` is returned in the list and search assets API and upload API.

items.docs:
You can programmatically get image EXIF, pHash, and other metadata for uploaded files in the ImageKit.io media library using this API.

You can also get the metadata in upload API response by passing `metadata` in `responseFields` parameter.

params.name: url
params.description: Should be a valid file URL. It should be accessible using your ImageKit.io account.

items.docs: Get image EXIF, pHash, and other metadata from ImageKit.io powered remote URL using this API.
